propositions: When a child's direct parent cannot be represented in Jira due to type collapse, the outbound differ suppresses the parent field, leaving the child without context
An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must name the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key and carry both the parent-breadcrumb tag and RECONCILER_MARKER for inbound suppression
The breadcrumb is appended exactly once per child via stable identity tag dedup, preventing conflicting duplicates even if the nearest represented ancestor changes across passes
When the walk to find a bound ancestor skips unrepresented intervening levels, the breadcrumb body explicitly notes their absence in Jira
The breadcrumb is emitted from the outbound comment differ by integrating _build_parent_breadcrumb into _diff_comments with local_parents and local_ticket_types parameters
Breadcrumb comments are suppressed inbound by the RECONCILER_MARKER substring check in _diff_comments_inbound, preventing echo-loop
